scope: Configuration-explicit power-to-mass metrics calculated from normalized public technical claims.
notes: Five power-to-mass rows cover four entities because Challenger 2 baseline and add-on-armour masses remain separate configurations.
The Leclerc mass range produces an ascending power-to-mass interval and is not collapsed to a midpoint.
Every metric records its exact input claim indexes, normalized values, original values, qualifiers and sources.
Any input claim index or expected field drift fails CI and requires manual review.
The metric output is derived data and is never written back into canonical technical claims.
